See how your Helm chart is wired

Drop in a chart. Helm renders it right here in your browser, then every reference between its resources is traced: selectors, mounts, routes, RBAC, certificates, network policies and service DNS names. Links that cross namespaces are highlighted. Nothing is uploaded.

Drop a chart folder, .tgz or .zip here

The folder that contains Chart.yaml, with every dependency already in its charts/ folder.
Run helm dependency build first if they come from a repository: this page cannot download them.

Pasted YAML is analysed in your browser and is not sent anywhere.
